alchemia.effect.returning.description: Opens a shimmering door home to your bed. Step through, then step back before it fades. Each level holds the door for another round trip.
alchemia.effect.teleportation.descriptio: Flings the drinker to a random safe place far away, 1,500 blocks further with each level. Splashed creatures only hop a short way.
alchemia.effect.attraction.description: Pulls loose items toward you like a magnet. Each level reaches farther.
alchemia.effect.treasure_vision.descript: Ore veins glimmer through solid stone in their own colours. Sight reaches 15 blocks, and 10 more with each level.
alchemia.effect.dangersense.description: Creatures that mean you harm, and traps lying in wait, are washed in red.
alchemia.effect.flames.description: Spills a pool of clinging fire wherever it breaks, burning for several seconds. Best thrown, unless you are fireproof.
alchemia.effect.thorns.description: Turns a quarter of every blow back on the attacker, a quarter more with each level.
alchemia.effect.recall.description: Tears reality open and drops the drinker home at their spawn point, be it a bed, an anchor or the world's spawn. Splashed creatures are sent to the world's spawn.
alchemia.effect.wild_growth.description: Plants nearby grow far faster, and your footsteps leave flowers and tall grass behind. Each level reaches one step further back along the ground: dirt to grass, then coarse dirt to dirt, gravel to coarse dirt, and at level IV sand to gravel. Enough of that greens a desert into plains, and in time plains into a flower forest, where the odd tree may sprout. Splashed, it bursts into growth at once.
